content:
As the iPhone Duo launch date approaches, Apple is now accepting submissions for apps and games optimised for iPhone Duo, with development requiring Xcode 27.1. Details are as follows.

Starting April 2027, App Store Connect will require submissions to include iPhone Duo screenshots

Over the past few weeks, Apple has陆续 released beta versions of Xcode 27.1 to support iPhone Duo app and game development and testing. Apple today released Xcode 27.1 Release Candidate 1, available for download here.

Apple posted an article on its Developer News Hub this morning, announcing that developers can now submit apps and games optimised for iPhone Duo through App Store Connect:

When you build or recompile with Xcode 27.1, your App Store product page will display a badge indicating that your app has been optimised for iPhone Duo.

Apple also specifically noted that from April 2027, all apps or games submitted to App Store Connect must include screenshots suitable for iPhone Duo.

In the same announcement, Apple emphasised that developers only need to recompile existing apps with Xcode 27.1 to add support for iPhone Duo development. Developers can also preview how their apps perform in different postures and orientations on the new device through the Device Hub.

Apple also listed several resources to help developers prepare their apps and App Store product pages for iPhone Duo, including:

  • Access design guidelines and templates
  • Manage your App Store assets
  • View app preview specifications
  • View screenshot specifications

Apple will be hosting several in-person iPhone Duo workshops over the coming days; click here for details and registration.

iPhone Duo will be available for pre-order from Friday, 16 October, with shipping and in-store availability beginning 23 October.

Apple previously announced that customers can prepare for iPhone Duo pre-orders from 12 October; click here for details.

To read Apple's full announcement, click here.
